articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team reports 5K findings in sweeping security audit
articles.snippet: “There’s a lot of chaos right now in the ecosystem. We absolutely understand that many people are being bombarded with security issues right now,” said Bitcoin developer Calle.

articles.title: Tokyo Tells Trump to Stop Meme-ing Mario
articles.snippet: Tokyo has asked Washington to stop meme-posting Mario, Pokémon, and Naruto without permission in a clash between meme-heavy statecraft and strict IP norms.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Bridge Shut Itself Down Because AI Was Finding Bugs Too Fast
articles.snippet: Non-custodial Bitcoin swap provider Boltz says attackers are finding vulnerabilities faster than its team can fix them, forcing it to suspend swaps indefinitely.
